source: Constructed generic linked exile return fixtures

cards.name: Generic Immediate Blink
cards.oracle_text: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.

cards.name: Generic Delayed Blink
cards.oracle_text: Exile target creature. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.

cards.name: Generic Group Blink
cards.oracle_text: Exile up to two target creatures you control, then return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control.

cards.name: Generic Counter Blink
cards.oracle_text: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it.

cards.name: Generic Keyword Blink
cards.oracle_text: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control. It gains first strike until end of turn.

cards.name: Generic Self Blink
cards.oracle_text: {W}: Exile this creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.

cards.name: Generic Optional Entry Blink
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may exile another target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.

cards.name: Generic Blink Entry Witness
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, draw a card.

cards.name: Generic Blink Bounce
cards.oracle_text: Return target creature to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Generic Blink Counter Doubler
cards.oracle_text: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, twice that many +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.

cards.name: Generic Blink Counter Addition
cards.oracle_text: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.

cards.name: Generic Optional Other Blink
cards.oracle_text: {W}: Exile up to one other target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
